core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix 'Premium Hotel' warmth with 'Clinical' precision.
Content is King: Every service card tells a story of comfort.
Zoom In: Use intimate, high-quality portraits of care interactions.
Negative Space: Generous padding (p-8 to p-16) to create breathing room.
Contrast: Deep Navy text against soft Sand/White backgrounds for readability.
hall_of_shame: No sharp, hard borders without softness.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H3 headings. Major brand statements.
headings.case: Sentence case for natural reading, Uppercase for small labels only.

body.usage: All paragraphs, inputs, and UI text.

primary.description: Deep Navy (Midnight) - Replaces the old teal-navy for a more serious, premium feel.

accent.description: Champagne Gold - Use for subtle highlights, active states, and borders.

bento_grid.description: Use for Services and Features. Mix wide tiles (span-2) with tall tiles (row-span-2).

rtl_support.instruction: All flex/grid layouts must use logical properties (start/end) or standard flex behavior which auto-flips in RTL. Test with dir='rtl' on html tag.

glassmorphism.usage: Use for all Cards, Floating Navs, and Modals.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-medium shadow-lg transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-primary border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-medium

cards.service_card: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white p-8 transition-all hover:shadow-[0_20px_40px_-4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] border border-slate-100

inputs.style: rounded-xl border-slate-200 bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-sm focus:border-primary focus:ring-primary/20 h-12

images.guidelines: Use high-quality, authentic photography. Warm lighting, genuine smiles, clean medical environments.

selected_assets.alt: Two women laughing together indoors - conveys warmth and connection
selected_assets.usage: Hero Section Background or Main Feature Image

selected_assets.alt: Doctor consulting with patient in modern clinic
Group of elderly people gathered together

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1_setup: Update tailwind.config.js with the new 'Midnight & Champagne' palette and fonts. Install fonts in index.css.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2_layout: Refactor the main layout to use 'max-w-7xl' and generous padding. Ensure RTL direction is handled via 'dir=rtl' on the HTML tag in index.html (or dynamically).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3_components: Update Button, Card, and Input components in /ui to match the 'Premium Luxury' rounded/glass style.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4_pages: Redesign the Landing Page first using the 'Hero' image and 'Bento' grid for services.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5_dashboard: Apply the 'Glassmorphism' sidebar and 'Card' style to the Provider/User dashboards. Keep data dense but readable with Manrope font.
instructions_to_main_agent.critical_check: Ensure all text has sufficient contrast (Navy on Sand/White). Do not use pure black.

do_not: Use default shadcn radius (use rounded-2xl or rounded-full).
